title: The minimal width of universal $p$-adic ReLU neural networks
abstract: arXiv:2603.00064v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We determine the minimal width of $p$-adic neural networks with the universal approximation property for continuous $\mathbb Q_p$-valued functions on compact open subsets with respect to the $L_q$ norms and the $C_1$ norm, where the activation function is a natural $p$-adic analogue of the ReLU function.

Abstract: arXiv:2603.00064v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We determine the minimal width of $p$-adic neural networks with the universal approximation property for continuous $\mathbb Q_p$-valued functions on compact open subsets with respect to the $L_q$ norms and the $C_1$ norm, where the activation function is a natural $p$-adic analogue of the ReLU function.
translated_title: 万能 $p$-adic ReLU 神经网络的最小宽度
translated_abstract: 我们确定了具有万能逼近性质的 $p$-adic 神经网络的最小宽度，该性质是针对紧开子集上连续的 $\mathbb Q_p$-值函数在 $L_q$ 范数和 $C_1$ 范数意义下的逼近，其中激活函数是 ReLU 函数的一种自然的 $p$-adic 类比。
tldr: 本文确定了以自然 $p$-adic ReLU 类似函数为激活函数的 $p$-adic 神经网络，在 $L_q$ 范数和 $C_1$ 范数意义下对紧开子集上连续 $\mathbb Q_p$-值函数具有万能逼近性质所需的最小宽度。
en_tdlr: This paper determines the minimal width of $p$-adic neural networks with a natural $p$-adic analogue of the ReLU activation function to achieve the universal approximation property for continuous $\mathbb Q_p$-valued functions on compact open subsets under the $L_q$ norms and the $C_1$ norm.
